hevy-revanced.description: Hevy Morphe builds upon the original Hevy app by Hevy Corp., a workout tracker and planner for logging gym routines, tracking progress, and monitoring performance metrics. This modification applies a custom 'Unlock Pro features' patch from repositories like brosssh/revanced-patches to the package com.hevy, bypassing subscription costs for full premium access without specific version requirements. Users gain unlimited routines, custom exercises, graph history, body measurements logging, and advanced statistics for comprehensive fitness tracking.
